item.title: Chapter 1: A New Start
item.description: The doors are not what they seem in the first chapter of the greatest underhog story ever told.

item.title: Chapter 1: Prickly Past, Punctured Heart
item.description: Hege, a standout boy in a school of cats and dogs, has had a tough start in life.

item.title: Chapter 2: The Pursuit of Hegena
item.description: Hege paces nervously down the school corridors, and with a heavy heart, he glances at the remaining scraps of his diary filled with love notes to Hegena.

item.title: Chapter 3: Hegena's Birthday Party
item.description: Hegena, ever the social butterfly, is arranging her own very grand casino-themed birthday party, inviting all her classmates to indulge in an evening of glamour and fortune.

item.title: Chapter 4: It's All Fun and Games Until Someone Gets Burned
item.description: It's a blazing hot day in Hegeville, and it's that time of year again. Hegena's mom, Helena, is throwing her hegendary summer BBQ bash.

item.title: Chapter 5: The Class Trip
item.description: It's time for the highlight of school: a class trip. Hege, Hegena, Hendrix, and all their classmates are heading off to the planetarium to learn about space and stars.
